description: Every inbound route of the anonymous usage statistics module. health answers anyone (it only says the module is loaded); every other route answers the operator of the installation only (TR_EVER_ADMIN_EMAILS, default TR_ADMIN_EMAIL) and 403 to any other user or API client. With TR_EVER_STATS_ENABLED=false none of them exists (404).

routes.purpose: State and reason, next and last send, instance id, key id, country, install source; the webapp shows the menu entry only when it answers 200
What is sent: the report built now, checked, never sent or stored
The last 12 reports: the exact bytes, date, status and HTTP answer
Send now (409 while switched off or refused until an upgrade, 429 more than once per 10 minutes)
The operator's switch (409 cloud-managed when TR_EVER_INSTALL_SOURCE=cloud)
A new instance id and statistics key; the report history is cleared
